import json, os, re, sys

skip = {"node_modules", ".git", "dist", "build", ".svn", "vendor", "coverage"}
index = {}
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(REPO):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in skip]
    for f in files:
        if f.endswith((".vue", ".js", ".ts", ".tsx", ".jsx", ".json", ".html", ".scss", ".css")):
            index.setdefault(f, []).append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), REPO).replace("\\", "/"))

pathre = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_\-\./]+\.(?:vue|js|ts|tsx|jsx|json|html|scss|css)")

worksheet = []
for i, c in enumerate(sel["candidates"], 1):
    content = c["content"]
    lines = [l.strip() for l in content.split("\\n") if l.strip()]
    title = lines[0].lstrip("# ").strip() if lines else ""
    # gather referenced file tokens
    refs = set()
    for m in pathre.findall(content):
        base = m.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        refs.add(base)
    found, missing = [], []
    for base in sorted(refs):
        hits = index.get(base, [])
        if hits:
            found.append(base + " => " + ", ".join(hits[:3]))
        else:
            missing.append(base)
    worksheet.append(

        % (i, title, c["uri"], c["body_sha256_16"],

           " | ".join(missing) if missing else "(none)",
           "\n".join(lines[1:]))
    )

out = os.path.join(CACHE, "worksheet.txt")
open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(worksheet))
print("wrote", out, "candidates=", len(worksheet), "indexed_files=", len(index))
